adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `remove_member` using `group.users.delete(user_id)` (Admin::GroupsController#remove_member). In Rails, `collection.delete` on an association typically issues direct delete(s) against the join table and does not instantiate/destroy the join model, so any join-model destroy callbacks (and any counter-cache maintained via those callbacks) would be skipped. The diff also shows member adds go through `group.add(user)` (add_members), which likely uses the join model’s normal create path. If `user_count` is a persisted counter cache (suggested by the presence of `user_count` in serializers/UI), deletes via `group.users.delete` could cause it to drift.
